# Optimization

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## ActSeek

Compare candidate structures with an active-site-annotated reference.

Exact job name: `act_seek`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded file: `.pdb`, `.zip` |
| `reference_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded file: `.pdb` |
| `active_sites` | string | yes | value | Required comma-separated residue IDs, e.g. 105_A,224_A; every identifier must exist in reference_path PDB. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_path": {
      "description": "Uploaded file: `.pdb`, `.zip`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "reference_path": {
      "description": "Uploaded file: `.pdb`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "active_sites": {
      "description": "Required comma-separated residue IDs, e.g. 105_A,224_A; every identifier must exist in reference_path PDB.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "pattern": "^-?[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9](,-?[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9])*$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input_path",
    "reference_path",
    "active_sites"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "act_seek",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "input_path": "<user value; see input_path schema>",
    "reference_path": "<user value; see reference_path schema>",
    "active_sites": "<user value; see active_sites schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### File checks

    "formats": [
      "pdb",

    ],

  },

## Directed Evolution (MLDE)

Use machine-learning-guided directed evolution to generate a focused mutant library around selected residue positions and evaluate each sequence's physicochemical properties.

Exact job name: `Insilico_Directed_Evolution`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `property_name` | string | yes | value | Exact enum: `Thermal_Stability_Protbert`, `Thermal_Stability_ESM`, `Solubility_ESM`, `Antigen_Antibody_binding`, or `CDR_Prediction` |
| `fasta_path` | string | yes | file | Protein input reference accepted by the NodeAPI. For a file, upload it first and pass the returned path. The UI also exposes Dataset, File, and Sequence modes, but alternate JSON field names for those modes are not yet verified. |
| `positions` | string | yes | value | Space-separated residue-position tokens, e.g. `"I61 N40"` or `"A187 G190"`. Do not convert this to an integer array or comma-separated numeric indexes. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "positions": {
      "description": "Space-separated residue-position tokens, e.g. `\"I61 N40\"` or `\"A187 G190\"`. Do not convert this to an integer array or comma-separated numeric indexes.",

## Random Controlled Mutagenesis

Random Controlled Mutagenesis

Exact job name: `Random_Controlled_Mutagenesis`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seq` | string | yes | value | Input sequence (string, NOT list) |
| `n_samples` | integer | yes | value | Number of mutants |
| `file_format` | string | yes | value | CSV is the supported output format. |
| `indices` | array | yes | value | Zero-based protected positions excluded from mutation; at least one position must remain available. An empty array is allowed. |
| `mutaions_per_epoch` | integer | yes | value | Number of mutations per round. **API TYPO: spell it `mutaions_per_epoch` (missing the "t")** — the backend rejects the correct spelling `mutations_per_epoch` with `Schema validation failed: Mutations per epoch is required`. The skill docs and most reference files will say `mutations_per_epoch` but the live API only accepts the misspelled form. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "seq": {
      "description": "Input sequence (string, NOT list)",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "pattern": "^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+$"
    },
    "n_samples": {
      "description": "Number of mutants",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "file_format": {
      "description": "CSV is the supported output format.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "csv"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "indices": {
      "description": "Zero-based protected positions excluded from mutation; at least one position must remain available. An empty array is allowed.",
      "type": "array",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 0
      }
    },
    "mutaions_per_epoch": {
      "description": "Number of mutations per round. **API TYPO: spell it `mutaions_per_epoch` (missing the \"t\")** — the backend rejects the correct spelling `mutations_per_epoch` with `Schema validation failed: Mutations per epoch is required`. The skill docs and most reference files will say `mutations_per_epoch` but the live API only accepts the misspelled form.",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "seq",
    "n_samples",
    "file_format",
    "indices",
    "mutaions_per_epoch"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.

  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",

## Stability-Binding DDG

The experiment name belongs to top-level `experimentName` through the existing submission helper, not `experimentData.job_name`. The backend job is always `stability-binding-ddg`, never the sample experiment label or `stabddg`.

Exact job name: `stability-binding-ddg`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdb_path` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | Upload a PDB structure. Raw sequences, SMILES and PDB IDs are not structure uploads. |
| `sequence` | string | yes | value | Protein sequence for the selected chain. |
| `chain` | string | yes | value | Single uppercase protein chain ID; it must exist in the PDB when a structure is uploaded. |
| `mutations` | array | yes | value | One-based residue positions or ranges, e.g. [1, 2, "8-15"]. Preserve the chosen positions; do not invent substitutions. |
| `num_mutations` | string | yes | value | Requested count as a string, as required by the public payload. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "pdb_path": {
      "description": "Upload a PDB structure. Raw sequences, SMILES and PDB IDs are not structure uploads.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "sequence": {
      "description": "Protein sequence for the selected chain.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "chain": {
      "description": "Single uppercase protein chain ID; it must exist in the PDB when a structure is uploaded.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "mutations": {
      "description": "One-based residue positions or ranges, e.g. [1, 2, \"8-15\"]. Preserve the chosen positions; do not invent substitutions.",
      "type": "array",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "integer",
          "string"
        ]
      }
    },
    "num_mutations": {
      "description": "Requested count as a string, as required by the public payload.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sequence",
    "chain",
    "mutations",
    "num_mutations"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```
